name: slab-vscode
description: Lightweight markdown companion for Culmen study notes: themed external preview, LaTeX and table authoring helpers, and Culmen-friendly image handling.

slab.showStatusBarEntry.description: Show a Slab status bar entry when a markdown file or markdown notebook cell is active.

slab.activeTheme.description: Currently applied Slab LaTeX theme preset.

slab.latexColors.environmentKeyword.description: Color for LaTeX environment keywords like \begin and \end.

slab.latexColors.environmentName.description: Color for LaTeX environment names like equation and bmatrix.

slab.latexColors.greek.description: Color for Greek LaTeX commands like \alpha, \beta, and \theta.

slab.latexColors.command.description: Color for general LaTeX commands like \frac, \mathbb, and \mathbf.

slab.latexColors.inlineMath.description: Color for inline math spans like $...$.

slab.latexColors.blockMathForeground.description: Foreground color for block math spans like $$...$$.

slab.latexColors.blockMathBackground.description: Background color for block math spans like $$...$$.

scripts.smoke: node ./tests/smoke/activate.mjs && node ./tests/smoke/block-math-delimiters.mjs && node ./tests/smoke/math-insertion.mjs && node ./tests/smoke/preview-assets.mjs && node ./tests/smoke/popout-theme.mjs && node ./tests/smoke/table-model.mjs
